summary: Nova Minerals Ltd filed a 6-K announcing court approval of schemes of arrangement to be acquired by Nova Minerals Corp (US Holdco), a new US holding entity. All ordinary shares and Nasdaq listed warrants will be exchanged for interests in US Holdco. The schemes become effective upon lodgment with ASIC on June 3, 2026. Trading suspension begins June 3, with implementation expected June 16 and US Holdco listing on NYSE thereafter. No price per share or premium is disclosed. This is a redomestication going-private transaction via scheme of arrangement, shifting the corporate domicile from Australia to the US. What to watch: regulatory clearance and shareholder dissent rights under Australian law.
